name: ICD-10 WHO Version
description: WHO International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, modeled as a navigable classification hierarchy in OCL.

properties.description: OCL concept class used to distinguish the synthetic root, ICD-10 chapters, groups, and code concepts.
Position in the ICD-10 classification hierarchy emitted by the legacy import: root 0, chapter 1, group 2, code 3, and deeper source-specific levels where present.

Legacy ICD-10 classification-place flag preserved verbatim from the 10 November 2021 import artifact. Observed values are N and T; the tracked source artifact does not define their business meaning, so consumers must not infer a clinical assertion from this flag.
ICD-10 chapter number associated with the concept. The synthetic root has no chapter number.

Legacy terminal-node flag preserved verbatim from the 10 November 2021 import artifact. Observed values are X and S; it is not modeled as boolean until the upstream definition is recovered and validated.

filters.description: Focuses the concept list on billable/classification code concepts rather than the synthetic root and grouping nodes.
Example chapter filter for Chapter I. Change the value in a reviewed Source configuration only when the intended default filter changes.
Example filter for one observed legacy terminal-node value. Its operational meaning remains intentionally undocumented pending source evidence.
